Explore W.E.B. Du Bois's 700+ articles from *The Crisis* magazine organized by theme, person, place, or time period.

## Browse by Theme

Across twenty-four years, Du Bois returned to the same interlocking problems. These thematic pages collect his editorials by subject and trace how his arguments evolved.

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- [**The Color Line**](browse/themes/segregation.qmd) (144 articles) — Segregation and social equality
- [**The Mob**](browse/themes/racial-violence.qmd) (134 articles) — Lynching and racial violence
- [**Voting & Elections**](browse/themes/voting.qmd) (131 articles) — Disfranchisement and party strategy
- [**Labor & Economics**](browse/themes/labor-economics.qmd) (111 articles) — Union exclusion and cooperativism
- [**The South**](browse/themes/south.qmd) (90 articles) — Southern governance and migration
- [**The World**](browse/themes/pan-africanism.qmd) (90 articles) — Pan-Africanism and empire
- [**Education**](browse/themes/education.qmd) (78 articles) — Schools, funding, philanthropic control
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
- [**Internal Debate**](browse/themes/internal-debate.qmd) (72 articles) — Accommodationism, Garvey, NAACP methods
- [**Art & Culture**](browse/themes/art-culture.qmd) (61 articles) — Harlem Renaissance and Black institutions
- [**The Compact**](browse/themes/war.qmd) (57 articles) — War, military service, betrayal
- [**The Mission**](browse/themes/naacp.qmd) (51 articles) — Building the NAACP
- [**The Soul**](browse/themes/religion.qmd) (45 articles) — Religion and moral argument
- [**Women's Rights**](browse/themes/women.qmd) (41 articles) — Suffrage and political power
- [**The Artist**](browse/themes/literary.qmd) (36 articles) — Fiction, poetry, satire, allegory
:::
::::
